newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rugby Union - Auckland hooped jersey discarded for good.
newsitem.headline: Rugby Union - Auckland hooped jersey discarded for good.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Oct 7 - The Auckland rugby team will not be seen again in their traditional blue and white hooped jerseys, the New Zealand Herald reported on Monday.
Last Friday's 27-7 win against Waikato to start another Ranfurly Shield reign also signalled farewell to the old-style garments, the newspaper said.
Auckland Rugby Union chief executive Peter Scutts was adamant that Friday night "was a oncer", even if some of the senior players in the side still favoured the blue and white jersey.

Their traditional jersey was replaced this year by a patterned garment mixing a splash of red with the regular blue and white colours as apparel sponsor Nike and the ARU changed course in the new professional era.
After the new jersey did not show up too well under lights in a recent match in Wanganui, Scutts and the players decided to revert to the old hoops for the shield challenge in Hamilton.

"The major issue was that it was a very traditional occasion for the players and we never really had a chance to farewell the hooped jersey, and the players made a request to play in it for a final time," Scutts told the Herald.
